title: Seven Palms Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, expansive living spaces are crafted for gathering and entertaining, featuring soaring ceilings, a chef-inspired kitchen with premium appliances, and beautifully appointed dining and lounge areas. The home comfortably accommodates large groups with multiple king suites, custom bunk rooms, and inviting entertainment spaces across every level. Guests can enjoy amenities designed for the ultimate coastal getaway, including a six-seater golf cart, six adult bicycles, and complimentary seasonal beach setups. With easy beach access just a short walk away and every detail designed for comfort and style, this exceptional residence offers an unforgettable setting for a luxurious Gulf Coast escape. Perched just steps from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, this striking coastal retreat blends modern luxury with effortless beachside living. Designed across four impressive levels and crowned with a fourth-floor lookout deck, the home showcases sweeping Gulf views, elegant white-washed architecture, and thoughtfully curated interiors. A private elevator provides seamless access throughout, while expansive porches invite moments of relaxation with breathtaking sunset vistas. Outside, a resort-style pool and spa create a private oasis, complete with a spacious deck, summer kitchen, and shaded lounge areas perfect for enjoying the coastal breeze.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 2 - First Floor: Two Queen Over Queen Bunks
Bedroom 4 - Second Floor: Two Queen Over Queen Bunks
Bedroom 5 - Third Floor: King + Queen Over Queen Bunk
Bedroom 6 - Third Floor: King + Single Over Single Bunk
